arxiv-2011-12088.title: Möbius Strip Microlasers: a Testbed for Non-Euclidean Photonics
arxiv-2011-12088.creator: Yalei Song, Yann Monceaux, Stefan Bittner, Kimhong Chao, Héctor M. Reynoso de la Cruz, Clément Lafargue, Dominique Decanini, Barbara Dietz, Joseph Zyss, Alain Grigis, Xavier Checoury, Melanie Lebental
arxiv-2011-12088.description: Abstract We report on experiments with Möbius strip microlasers which were fabricated with high optical quality by direct laser writing. A Möbius strip, i.e., a band with a half twist, exhibits the fascinating property that it has a single nonorientable surface and a single boundary.

arxiv-2012-06424.title: Universal edge scaling in random partitions
arxiv-2012-06424.creator: Taro Kimura and Ali Zahabi
arxiv-2012-06424.description: Abstract We establish the universal edge scaling limit of random partitions with the infinite-parameter distribution called the Schur measure. We explore the asymptotic behavior of the wave function, which is a building block of the corresponding kernel, based on the Schrödinger-type differential equation.

arxiv-2204-01264.title: Probabilistic Implicit Scene Completion
arxiv-2204-01264.creator: Dongsu Zhang, Changwoon Choi, Inbum Park & Young Min Kim
arxiv-2204-01264.description: Abstract We propose a probabilistic shape completion method extended to the continuous geometry of large-scale 3D scenes. Real-world scans of 3D scenes suffer from a considerable amount of missing data cluttered with unsegmented objects. The problem of shape completion is inherently ill-posed, and high-quality result requires scalable solutions that consider multiple possible outcomes.

arxiv-2210-00606.title: Soft Particles and Infinite-Dimensional Geometry
arxiv-2210-00606.description: Abstract In the sigma model, soft insertions of moduli scalars enact parallel transport of S S -matrix elements about the finite-dimensional moduli space of vacua, and the antisymmetric double-soft theorem calculates the curvature of the vacuum manifold. We explore the analogs of these statements in gauge theory and gravity in asymptotically flat spacetimes, where the relevant moduli spaces are infinite-dimensional.

arxiv-2301-07051.title: ActSafe: Predicting Violations of Medical Temporal Constraints for Medication Adherence
arxiv-2301-07051.creator: Parker Seegmiller, Joseph Gatto, Abdullah Mamun, Hassan Ghasemzadeh, Diane Cook, John Stankovic, Sarah Masud Preum
arxiv-2301-07051.description: Abstract . Prescription medications often impose temporal constraints on regular health behaviors (RHBs) of patients, e.g., eating before taking medication. Violations of such medical temporal constraints (MTCs) can result in adverse effects. Detecting and predicting such violations before they occur can help alert the patient.

arxiv-2303-18079.title: Dispersion entropy: A Measure of Irregularity for Graph Signals
arxiv-2303-18079.creator: John Stewart Fabila-Carrasco 1 , Chao Tan 2 , and Javier Escudero 1
arxiv-2303-18079.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by John Stewart Fabila-Carrasco 1 , Chao Tan 2 , and Javier Escudero 1. We introduce a novel method, called Dispersion Entropy for Graph Signals, DE_G \DEG , as a powerful tool for analysing the irregularity of signals defined on graphs. We demonstrate the effectiveness of DE_G \DEG in detecting changes in the dynamics of signals defined on synthetic and real-world graphs, by defining mixed processing on random geometric graphs or those exhibiting with small-world properties.

arxiv-2405-19745.title: GaussianPrediction: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Prediction for Motion Extrapolation and Free View Synthesis Conference: Special Interest Group on Computer Graphics and Interactive Techniques Conference Conference Papers ’24; July 27-August 1, 2024; Denver, CO, USA Special Interest Group on Computer Graphics
arxiv-2405-19745.creator: Boming Zhao, Yuan Li, Ziyu Sun, Lin Zeng, Yujun Shen, Rui Ma, Yinda Zhang, Hujun Bao, Zhaopeng Cui
arxiv-2405-19745.description: Abstract . Forecasting future scenarios in dynamic environments is essential for intelligent decision-making and navigation, a challenge yet to be fully realized in computer vision and robotics. Traditional approaches like video prediction and novel-view synthesis either lack the ability to forecast from arbitrary viewpoints or to predict temporal dynamics.

arxiv-2406-16246.title: Bitangent surfaces and involutions of quartic surfaces
arxiv-2406-16246.creator: Igor Dolgachev, Shigeyuki Kondō
arxiv-2406-16246.description: Abstract Abstract. We study the congruence of bitangent lines of an irreducible surface in \mathbb{P}^{3} in arbitrary characteristic, with special attention to quartic surfaces with rational double points and, in particular, Kummer quartic surfaces. Keywords. Congruence of lines, bitangent surface, Kummer quartic surface 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification.

arxiv-2412-10764.title: Relative Differential Closure in Hardy Fields
arxiv-2412-10764.creator: Matthias Aschenbrenner, Lou van den Dries, Joris van der Hoeven
arxiv-2412-10764.description: Abstract . We study relative differential closure in the context of Hardy fields. Using our earlier work on algebraic differential equations over Hardy fields, this leads to a proof of a conjecture of Boshernitzan (1981): the intersection of all maximal analytic Hardy fields agrees with that of all maximal Hardy fields.

arxiv-2505-10488.title: Possibility of Multi-Messenger Observations of Quasi-Periodic Eruptions with X-rays and Gravitational Waves
arxiv-2505-10488.creator: Tomoya Suzuguchi, \altemailmark Hidetoshi Omiya, and Hiroki Takeda
arxiv-2505-10488.description: Abstract Recent X-ray observations have discovered a class of periodic X-ray flares in galactic nuclei known as quasi-periodic eruptions (QPEs). A promising explanation of QPEs is an emission produced when a stellar-mass object orbiting a central supermassive black hole crosses an accretion disk.

arxiv-2506-23737.title: Two-Dimensional Materials-Based Josephson Junctions
arxiv-2506-23737.creator: Hamidreza Simchi
arxiv-2506-23737.description: Abstract August 8, 2026 We consider a two-dimensional monolayer MoS 2 -based Josephson junction which is composed by an intermediate semiconductor flake and the semi-infinite topological and non-topological superconductor leads and study its quantum transport properties by using the tight-binding non-equilibrium Green function method.

pmc-10514371.creator: Masanori Hashimoto, Hirohito Hirata, Masatsugu Tsukamoto, Yoshihara Tomohito, Masaaki Mawatari, Tadatsugu Morimoto
pmc-10514371.description: Key Clinical MessageSpine surgeons should be aware of the possibility of anterior displacement of the grafted bone during PLIF and the potential for severe complications that may arise because of such displacement so that preparations can be made for a proper response.AbstractWe report two cases of anterior displacement of the grafted bone after posterior lumbar interbody fusion (Graphical Abstract A‐D).

pmc-10539639.title: Integrative metabolome and lipidome analyses of plasma in neovascular macular degeneration
pmc-10539639.creator: Tantai Zhao, Jiani Li, Yanbin Wang, Xiaojian Guo, Yun Sun
pmc-10539639.description: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) causes irreversible vision-loss among the elderly in industrial countries. Neovascular AMD (nAMD), which refers to late-stage AMD, is characterized by severe vision-threatening choroidal neovascularization (CNV). Herein, we constructed a global metabolic network of nAMD, based on untargeted metabolomic and lipidomic analysis of plasma samples collected from sixty subjects (30 nAMD patients and 30 age-matched controls).

pmc-10588002.title: Key factors for child participation – an empowerment model for active inclusion in participatory processes
pmc-10588002.creator: Rita Karoline Olsen
pmc-10588002.description: Child participation is advocated for in many contexts related to children, such as in education and health services, but also in everyday life settings. To facilitate children’s real opportunities for participation, it is proposed that children need to be adequately empowered to liberate the child’s autonomous voice and activate their powers of action.

pmc-11651444.title: Ankylosing spondylitis and cardiovascular disease: A two-sample Mendelian randomization analysis
pmc-11651444.creator: Huaigang Chen, Lang Hong, Hong Wang, Bin Li, Liu Yang
pmc-11651444.description: Epidemiological research has demonstrated that people suffering from ankylosing spondylitis (AS) have a greater chance of developing cardiovascular disease (CVD), though the potential link between AS genetics and CVD risk is uncertain. This research examined the potential link between CVD outcomes and AS which is genetically determined.

pmc-12039818.title: What interval of daily pain assessment is required to reliably diagnose chronic pain in SCD? The Pain in Sickle Cell Epidemiology Study
pmc-12039818.creator: Wally Renee Smith, Donna K McClish, Cecelia Valrie, India Sisler
pmc-12039818.description: ObjectivesChronic pain in SCD has been defined as pain on most days over 6 months. In the landmark Pain in Sickle Cell Epidemiology Study, 60% of patients submitted <5 of the expected 6 months of pain diaries. Identifying chronic SCD pain using this long daily assessment interval is impractical.

pmc-13069043.title: Tennis Serve Biomechanics, Joint Load Mechanics and Overuse Injuries: A Narrative Review
pmc-13069043.creator: Caroline Martin, Pierre Touzard, Loic Fourel, Babette M Pluim
pmc-13069043.description: BackgroundThe tennis serve is a fundamental stroke in a player’s performance during matches. But it may be also eminently traumatic as it causes very high joint mechanical loading which can lead to injury regardless of the player’s experience, sex or age.

pmc-13199490.title: NEK2 promotes oral squamous cell carcinoma progression and serves as a diagnostic and therapeutic target
pmc-13199490.creator: HaiYing Wu, SiYing Huang, NingXiang Wu, WeiHua Chen
pmc-13199490.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). NIMA - related kinase 2 (NEK2), belonging to the NIMA family, is intricately linked to tumorigenesis and tumor progression. Nevertheless, its biological functions and underlying mechanisms in oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) remain elusive. The protein expression level of NEK2 in clinical OSCC samples was evaluated using immunohistochemical staining, and its prognostic impact on OSCC patients was analyzed via Kaplan-Meier survival analysis.

pmc-13341893.title: Deep learning improves image quality in motion-robust and sedation-free pediatric brain MRI
pmc-13341893.creator: Anna Magdalena Baz, Zeynep Bendella, Christoph Katemann, Alois M. Sprinkart, Kilian Weiss, Oliver M. Weber, Johannes M. Peeters, Nils C. Lehnen, Ralf Clauberg, Julian A. Luetkens, Alexander Radbruch, Barbara Daria Wichtmann

pmc-13617934.title: pH-responsive ion release kinetics of a chitosan-based hydrogel incorporating nanohydroxyapatite and sodium fluoride for enamel remineralization
pmc-13617934.creator: Azade Rafiee, Mahtab Memarpour, Hasan Rezazadeh, Amir Azadi, Neda Fekri, Tommy Baumann, Nima Farshidfar
pmc-13617934.description: BackgroundIon-releasing dental varnishes vary in composition and pH responsiveness, influencing remineralization efficacy. This study aimed to compare pH-responsive multi-ion release profiles of (1) sodium fluoride (NaF) varnish, (2) casein phosphopeptide–amorphous calcium phosphate (CPP-ACP)/NaF varnish, and (3) a newly synthesized NaF/nanohydroxyapatite (nHA)‑loaded chitosan (CS) hydrogel.

uslaw-usc-t27-s203.title: 27 U.S.C. § 203 — Unlawful businesses without permit; application to State agency
uslaw-usc-t27-s203.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t27-s203.description: United States Code, Title 27 (Intoxicating Liquors); Chapter 8 (Federal Alcohol Administration Act); Subchapter I (Federal Alcohol Administration). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In order effectively to regulate interstate and foreign commerce in distilled spirits, wine, and malt beverages, to enforce the twenty-first amendment, and to protect the revenue and enforce the postal laws with respect to distilled spirits, wine, and malt.
